cases.name: Ginger C. Clark
cases.about: Her obituary said, " Ginger was an alumni of SUNY Plattsburgh, leading her to working a majority of her career with New York State Taxation and Finance and later retiring as a Computer Programmer from New York State Temporary Disability Assistance Department. She also worked part-time as a waitress for several restaurants throughout the capital district. Ginger’s greatest love was for her family, taking care of her home, flowers, and gardening. Ginger was an avid reader and always kept active, walking outside and exercising or playing board games."
